title: Local Tapas Tour
text: We are a small, private concierge agency. We booked directly with Patricio and her team for our clients who wanted a local, tapas experience. They absolutely enjoyed it! Not only was their guide, Juli, flexible with their tour but encouraged them to try new things that they ended up loving! We would absolutely recommend to all of our travelers!
author: Sunshine21964080853

title: It was a great way to...
text: It was a great way to enjoy a preset route, learn some history, make some stops for some sweet treats, and duck into cute alleys! A great preview to the city!
author: Elizabeth_R
